key.name: active
key.summary: Master switch for every effect

key.name: snow-enabled
key.summary: Show falling snow

key.name: flake-count
key.summary: Number of snowflakes on a 1920×1080 monitor (scaled by monitor area)

key.name: flake-size
key.summary: Snowflake size multiplier

key.name: fall-speed
key.summary: Fall speed multiplier

key.name: wind
key.summary: Steady wind, negative blows left and positive blows right

key.name: snow-in-front
key.summary: Draw snow in front of windows instead of only on the desktop

key.name: pause-on-fullscreen
key.summary: Hide snow on monitors showing a fullscreen window

key.name: pile-enabled
key.summary: Let snow pile up on top of windows

key.name: pile-max-height
key.summary: Maximum height of a snow pile in pixels

key.name: pile-rate
key.summary: How quickly snow builds up

key.name: countdown-enabled
key.summary: Show a Christmas countdown in Quick Settings

key.name: sleigh-bells-enabled
key.summary: Play soft sleigh bells instead of the notification sound

key.name: cover-enabled
key.summary: Let snow cover monitors that are not in use
key.description: A monitor is idle while the pointer is on another monitor and the focused window is not on it. The cover melts when the pointer comes back.

key.name: cover-max-opacity
key.summary: Maximum opacity of the idle-monitor snow cover, in percent

key.name: scenery-enabled
key.summary: Replace the wallpaper with a full-screen winter scene

key.name: scenery-height
key.summary: Height of the landscape at the bottom of the scene, as a percentage of the monitor height; the sky fills the rest

key.name: aurora-enabled
key.summary: Show animated northern lights in the night scene

key.name: shooting-stars-enabled
key.summary: Show an occasional shooting star in the night scene

key.name: lights-twinkle
key.summary: Make the lights on the Christmas tree in the scene twinkle
